item.title: Attorney General Ellison wins second lawsuit against Trump Administration HUD to protect federal support for homelessness services
item.description:
Publication Date: August 10, 2026

Latest win comes after winning first lawsuit just six weeks ago against HUD’s continued illegal efforts to undermine program that support permanent housing for people facing housing security or experiencing homelessness
